results.title: DRI Cracks Down on Gold Smuggling, Seizes Gold at Toll Plaza and Railway Stations
results.description: The DRI has seized 7.8 kg of foreign-origin gold worth over ₹11.5 crore and arrested six people in operations across West Bengal. The crackdown uncovered suspected smuggling routes linked to the Bangladesh border, with gold recovered from a car and passengers at railway stations.

results.description: The US military has disabled a Panama-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman after it allegedly ignored warnings and attempted to breach Washington's blockade of Iranian ports. CENTCOM said the strike damaged the ship's propulsion system without injuring its crew, as restrictions continue to disrupt commercial shipping in the region. results.title: Brinjal, buffalo, bacteria: Inside India’s pay-for-nature system
results.description: India collected Rs. 9.68 crore in six months from businesses using the country’s biological resources. But the more interesting question is what happens to that money. Sometimes a farmer gets paid. Sometimes a research institution benefits. And sometimes the money is distributed among states because nobody knows which farmer supplied the original resource.

results.title: Pimpri-Chinchwad: Journalist Held For Extorting ₹10,000 From Rahatani Spa Owner
results.description: The Anti-Extortion Cell of the Pimpri-Chinchwad Crime Branch caught a 35-year-old journalist allegedly accepting ₹10,000 from a spa owner as part of a ₹50,000 extortion demand. The suspect allegedly threatened to publish adverse reports against the business and have it shut down if the owner refused to pay. He also allegedly threatened to kill the owner if he created trouble
